risks.title: Global economic conditions
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to global economic conditions, which may impact its revenues and operating results. The language used in the 10-K is cautious, indicating heightened vigilance regarding economic slowdowns.

risks.title: Intense competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market with multiple rival companies offering similar products. However, Vishay relies on its growth strategy and broad product portfolio to maintain its competitive position.

risks.title: End market dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is dependent on demand from targeted end markets, such as automotive and industrial. A decline in demand in these key sectors could significantly impact revenues.

risks.title: Production and supply chain risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to production risks, such as component shortages and quality issues. The company has implemented strategies to manage these risks, including optimization of its manufacturing footprint.

risks.title: Financial and liquidity risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to financial risks, such as interest rate fluctuations and changes in credit conditions. Shareholder return policy and expansion investments affect capital management.

risks.title: Regulatory and compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to regulatory risks related to changes in laws and regulations. However, the company appears to have a solid understanding of these risks and appropriate strategies to manage them.

risks.title: Management and succession risks
risks.score_rationale: The company implemented a new management team in 2023 (Vishay 3.0) promoted internally. The company is exposed to key talent retention and succession risks, but has an experienced team in place.
